working_definition: A future candidate must infer and update partner-relevant hidden causal state from partial observations, then use that update for counterfactual partner prediction or action under heldout partner-family and task-schema transfer, in a way faithful decoder, table, count, trace, retrieval, and leakage baselines cannot match under fair callable access.
bounded_evidence_claims_allowed_if_futur: hidden partner-relevant state inference under uncertainty

required_evidence_targets.minimum_evidence: candidate uses partial observations to update hidden partner-relevant state and beats faithful baselines on heldout families
state update changes behavior and degrades under remove-update and freeze-memory ablations
candidate recomputes under counterfactual partner interventions not present as trace fragments
heldout partner families and heldout task schemas are consumed and not schema-leaking
real ablation reruns under intervention degrade the claimed update path
replay recomputes behavior from serialized_state plus observation and stale-cache failure path blocks

required_evidence_targets.future_claim_limit: baseline non-equivalence inside this task family only
required_evidence_targets.minimum_evidence: strongest faithful non-oracle baseline remains below candidate under frozen acceptance rule

claim_ceiling: future evidence target contract only; no execution or mechanism claim
